_about: Outside calorie references per template serving, checked by check_template_calories.py after every matcher run. kcal is the reference normalised to OUR serving (null when none is usable). status: ok (compare), serving_differs, not_comparable (the reason is in note), none. See RECIPE_RULES.md, 'Calorie reference'. First filled by the 11-13 Nov 2026 audit.

dashi_stock.basis: Product label: 8 g powder per 2 cups water, 4 g per cup

chashu_pork.basis: 379 per serving; Biting at the Bits serves 2 slices, so ~190 per slice
chashu_pork.note: Slice size: 2 lb raw belly cut into 16 slices is 2 oz raw belly a slice, counted as raw pork belly (518 kcal/100 g, none of the rendered fat lost). References' slices are thinner. Drives shoyu ramen too.

tonkatsu_.basis: per serving (no nutrition on own sources; Christie at Home)

pork_and_vegetable_miso_soup.note: Pork belly now skin-on Foundation (341 → 276); tonjiru uses skinless belly in Japan, so the line could say "skinless pork belly".

japanese_beef_and_potato_stew.note: Yukon gold potato is now the general raw potato (live alias): 346 → 387.

teriyaki_chicken.basis: mean of Okonomi Kitchen 450 and RecipeTin Japan 442, both 2 servings

ginger_pork.note: Recipe amount: 10 oz pork loin for 2 (5 oz each, 280 kcal); Norecipes splits a similar amount 3 ways. Matches are right.

shrimp_tempura.basis: mean of Food Faith Fitness 210 and XOXO Bella 185 (4 servings each)
shrimp_tempura.note: Absorbed oil: 5 tbsp for 16 large shrimp is 150 of the 294 kcal. At the 15% wet-battered rate the shrimp (USDA large) would take far less; the line amount looks high for the rate. Oil amounts are Arianna's.

vegetable_tempura.note: Absorbed oil: 210 of 421 kcal. 7 tbsp is 15% (wet-battered) of the ~925 g of vegetables, so it follows the rate; reference counts much less oil. "1 small eggplant" is USDA's only eggplant, 500 g.

yakitori_.basis: Refs give per plate (236/6, 290/4), not per skewer
yakitori_.note: Ours is per skewer (8); references serve 4-6 plates. Per-skewer not stated.

okonomiyaki_.note: Pork belly now skin-on Foundation (736 → 643): 5 oz in 2 pancakes. Japanese belly is sold skinless; the line could say "skinless pork belly".

gyoza_.basis: 447 per serving of 8, yield in pieces not stated
gyoza_.note: Per piece (30); references don't give pieces per serving.

japanese_beef_curry.basis: 543 per cup of curry + 1 cup cooked rice (242), as ours includes

oyakodon_.note: Rice: 1⅓ cups cooked rice (322 kcal) and 5 oz thigh per bowl. Recipe amounts.

katsudon_.basis: Its 2201 per bowl looks like a batch total

omurice_.basis: mean of Norecipes 552 and Okonomi Kitchen 570

japanese_fried_rice.basis: 1026 for the whole batch as one lunch
japanese_fried_rice.note: Reference serves the batch as 1; ours is 2.

salmon_onigiri.note: Rice per ball: 105 g (½ cup+) per onigiri; reference serving size unknown.

salmon_nigiri.note: Rice per piece follows the settled 15 g rule (21 Oct); Pinch and Swirl's 87 implies more rice and fish. Not a fault.

inari_sushi.basis: 537 per serving of 3 pouches (12 pouches / 4); Norecipes 376/2 = 188

cucumber_salad.basis: mean of Caroline's 26 and Pickled Plum 48

japanese_potato_salad.note: Recipe amounts: 3 medium russets (USDA 213 g each) and 6 tbsp mayo (141 kcal a serving) for 4. Matches are right.

agedashi_tofu.note: Absorbed oil: 2 tbsp (75 kcal a serving) is the 8% starch-dusted rate on 14 oz tofu; references count less oil. Oil rates are Arianna's.

udon_noodle_soup.note: Ours (one 250 g udon pack + dashi) sits between.

shoyu_ramen.basis: mean of Feed Me Better 865 and Ramen Kaonashi 700, per bowl
shoyu_ramen.note: Chashu: 2 slices are 4 oz raw pork belly, 588 kcal, half the bowl (see chashu_pork). Plus 1 tbsp oil.

zaru_soba.note: Serving size: 2 cups cooked soba (228 g) per plate, less noodle than the reference's single serving. Recipe amount.

strawberry_mochi.basis: 185 per 3 pieces is ~62 a piece, implausibly low
strawberry_mochi.note: Only reference found isn't credible per piece.

dorayaki_.basis: references disagree: 367 per dorayaki (Pickled Plum) vs ~136 (Chopstick, 271 per 2)

coffee_jelly.basis: 5 kcal: jelly only, no cream or syrup
coffee_jelly.note: Reference leaves out the cream and sugar ours includes.

beef_tapa.note: Ours is per slice (24 a batch, 1 oz sirloin each); reference per 100 g.

longganisa_.basis: per piece: Foxy Folksy 129, Recipes by Nora 120 (24 each)

chicken_adobo.note: Skin and pieces per serving: each piece is a skin-on thigh, USDA 193 g (426 kcal). The weight is right: Australia's AUSNUT 2023 puts a medium thigh with skin at 195 g. Skin is about half its calories (skinless ≈ 180 kcal); Foxy Folksy's 374 points to smaller or skinless pieces. Judgement: is the skin eaten.

lechon_kawali.basis: 630 per 8 servings = 315 per slice at our 16 slices
lechon_kawali.note: Skin-on pork belly is now USDA's Foundation belly with skin (385 kcal/100 g; was the old SR belly at 518): 297 → 222. Bite My Bun's figure was likely calculated from the old 518 value.

daing_na_bangus.basis: Own sources list no nutrition (FatSecret-type listings 200-350 only)

brown_sugar_syrup.basis: Sources are drink/taho recipes, no syrup figure

pork_sinigang.basis: mean of Nora 656 (6) and Hungry Huy 607 (8)
pork_sinigang.note: Both references calculated from USDA's old SR pork belly: Nora's 1½ lb belly for 6 gives 60 g fat at 53% (page: 61 g); Hungry Huy's 1 lb belly + 1 lb ribs for 8 gives about 43 g (page: 45.6 g). Ours uses the skin-on Foundation belly: 549.

shrimp_sinigang.note: Head-on shrimp: 1 lb head-on is counted at 46% meat (USDA AH-102), 52 g a serving. Amount is the recipe's.

chicken_tinola.note: Ours 366 sits between the references. Thigh weight confirmed (see chicken_adobo); skin is often left in tinola, so a skinless line may fit.

bulalo_.note: Beef shank: USDA has only "Beef shank crosscuts, lean only" (128 kcal/100 g) and bone marrow isn't counted. Cut green beans fixed (canned → raw).

beef_nilaga.note: Brisket: 2 lb whole brisket (1/8" fat) for 6 = 5.3 oz each, 382 kcal. Matches right; reference's meat amount or cut is leaner.

pork_adobo.note: Reference calculated from USDA's old SR pork belly: Panlasang Pinoy's 2 lb belly for 4 at 518 kcal/100 g is 1,175 kcal and 120 g fat, the page prints 1,211 and 120 g. Ours uses the skin-on Foundation belly (385): 907.

kare_kare.basis: mean of Foxy Folksy 865 (6) and Hungry Huy 363 (8)
kare_kare.note: Oxtail is counted at USDA's 0.56 bone-and-cooking yield (85 g meat, 219 kcal a serving), settled 28 Oct. References disagree widely (363 vs 865); ours is inside that range.

beef_mechado.basis: mean of Foxy Folksy 697 (4) and Panlasang Pinoy 361 (6)

pork_menudo.note: Pork shoulder 2.25 lb for 6 (331 kcal each, via the braised-butt alias at 0.73 yield ≈ raw). Recipe amount.

bistek_tagalog.basis: mean of Bite My Bun 228 and Nora 240

sisig_.note: Lechon kawali sub-template: skin-on belly now the Foundation row (679 → 528).

bicol_express.basis: 289 for 1.25 lb pork belly + coconut milk per 4 is not possible (belly alone is ~730)
bicol_express.note: Reference implausible (289 for 1.25 lb belly + coconut per 4). Ours: belly now skin-on Foundation, chilies now small peppers (1,182 → 948) + 1½ cups coconut milk and ⅔ cup cream for 4.

chicken_inasal.note: Leg quarter: USDA's "1 leg with skin" is 344 g (thigh, drumstick and back), 736 kcal, consistent with the confirmed thigh weight. Judgement: one skin-on leg quarter a serving.

lechon_paksiw.note: Lechon kawali sub-template: skin-on belly now the Foundation row (886 → 685), within 1% of Nora's 680.

dinuguan_.note: Pork belly now the skin-on Foundation row (715 → 564). Remaining gap: pork amount.

embutido_.note: Ours is per serving of 12 (2 a log) → 386 per half log would compare; ours 455.

kinilaw_.basis: 40 for 1 lb fish per 4 is not possible
kinilaw_.note: Reference implausible (40 kcal for 1 lb fish per 4). Ours: 5 oz tuna (155) + Thai chili now counted as a serrano pepper (6.1 g; was 45 g).

ginisang_monggo.basis: mean of Panlasang Pinoy 410 and Bite My Bun 279
ginisang_monggo.note: Pork belly now skin-on Foundation (647 → 572). Recipe amounts: 1¼ cups dried mung beans + 8 oz pork belly for 4.

tocilog_.note: Tocino 5 oz (234) + 1 cup garlic rice with 2 tsp oil + fried egg. Recipe amounts; Norecipes plates are smaller.

bangsilog_.basis: 1425 per plate looks like a batch figure

adobo_fried_rice.note: Skin-on thigh meat (121 g, 267 kcal) + 1⅛ cups rice. Thigh weight confirmed (see chicken_adobo); the gap is skin and amounts.

lumpia_shanghai.note: Ours is the large roll (20 a batch), so per piece is bigger by design; per batch ours 2,660 vs Foxy Folksy 1,680.

lumpia_shanghai_small.basis: per small piece (35 a batch); Tasty 32 (50 a batch)

atchara_.note: Ours per 2 tbsp-style serving (24); jar basis not comparable.

water_spinach_adobo.note: Recipe amount: 2 tbsp oil for 4 (60 kcal each) is most of it; Panlasang Pinoy splits a similar pan 3 ways. Small absolute gap.

laing_.basis: mean of Panlasang Pinoy 618 (8) and Foxy Folksy 380 (5)
laing_.note: Coconut: 3 cups coconut milk + 1 cup cream for 6 (635 kcal a serving). Recipe amount. Dried taro leaves are counted as raw leaves (minor).

chop_suey.basis: 668 per 3 servings, recipe has more meat
chop_suey.note: Only reference found is a meat-heavy version.

tokwa_t_baboy.basis: mean of Bite My Bun 584 (4) and Nora 480 (8)
tokwa_t_baboy.note: Pork belly now the skin-on Foundation row (799 → 648): 1.5 lb belly for 6 (4 oz raw each).

pancit_bihon.basis: mean of Panlasang Pinoy 193 and Quirino 151 (6 each)
pancit_bihon.note: Rice vermicelli was cooked white rice (fixed → Rice noodles, cooked; 347 → 337). Cut green beans fixed. Remaining gap is recipe amounts: 3 tbsp oil (80 kcal a serving) and more chicken than the references.

pancit_canton.note: Pork belly now skin-on Foundation (471 → 421). Recipe amounts: belly 1.5 oz raw + 1 cup egg noodles a serving.

pancit_palabok.note: Rice vermicelli fixed (→ Rice noodles, cooked) and pork belly now skin-on Foundation: 517 → 460.

filipino_spaghetti.note: Recipe amounts: a whole hot dog (177), 3.3 oz ground pork (248) and 1¼ cups spaghetti a plate.

la_paz_batchoy.basis: 1240 per bowl looks like a batch figure

pancit_malabon.note: Ours serves 9; Nora's 16 servings. Rice noodles were cooked white rice (fixed).

leche_flan.basis: 81 per slice of 12 is too low for yolks + condensed milk

halo_halo.basis: 195 per tall glass with ice cream and milk looks low
halo_halo.note: Reference doubtful; ours includes ½ cup ice cream (137) and ¼ cup evaporated milk.

turon_.note: Absorbed oil 70 kcal a roll (8% wrapper rate) + brown sugar. Reference counts little oil. Oil rates are Arianna's.

banana_cue.note: Brown sugar: 3 tbsp per skewer (140 kcal) counted fully; most caramel stays on, but some is left in the pan. Plus oil 90. Judgement.

biko_.basis: mean of Hungry Huy 621 and Foxy Folksy 455 (9 slices each)

puto_.note: Ours 18 a batch with ~1 tbsp+ rice flour each: bigger cakes.

buko_pandan.basis: No usable figure (Panlasang Pinoy prints 4217 per serving)

cassava_cake.basis: 1023 per 6 servings, rescaled to our 15 pieces from a similar batch

taho_.note: References use more syrup and pearls per glass. Ours: 208 g silken tofu, 2 tbsp dry pearls, 3 tbsp syrup.

ginataang_bilo_bilo.note: Recipe amounts: 4 cups coconut milk + 1 cup cream + ¾ cup sugar for 8 (467 kcal from those). Matches right.

polvoron_.basis: 769 per serving of 8, pieces not stated
polvoron_.note: Ours per piece (13). Toasted rice flakes (pinipig) match cooked rice (minor; see open items).

sago_t_gulaman.note: Recipe amounts: 2 tbsp dry pearls and about 2 tbsp brown sugar syrup a glass; Panlasang Pinoy is sweeter.

mango_shake.note: One whole mango (336 g) + 2 tbsp sugar in one shake; Simply Bakings splits a similar blend in 2.

tsokolate_.basis: 16 per cup with tablea is not possible
tsokolate_.note: Reference implausible. Ours: 1.5 oz unsweetened chocolate (273) + sugar per cup.

bolognese_sauce.note: Ours 272 per ½ cup vs ~400 per ½ cup by the reference.

minestrone_.basis: mean of Family Style 185 and Gathering Dreams 247 (6 each)

italian_wedding_soup.basis: mean of Spend with Pennies 376 and Scarlati 330 (6 each)
italian_wedding_soup.note: Acini di pepe: 8 oz dry pasta for 6 (134 kcal each) — already flagged CHECK AMOUNT as an estimate. Recipe amount.

stracciatella_soup.note: Serving size: reference's serving is 100 g; ours is 1½ cups broth + 1 egg + 2 tbsp parmesan.

eggplant_parmesan.basis: mean of Natasha 458 (8) and Petite Cook 390 (6)
eggplant_parmesan.note: Absorbed oil: 177 kcal a serving (12% breaded rate). Oil rates are Arianna's.

chicken_marsala.basis: Own sources not reached; calculator listings 240-570

chicken_cacciatore.basis: Own sources not reached; Once Upon a Chef lists 790 for 2 thighs a serving
chicken_cacciatore.note: Pieces per serving: 2 skin-on thighs a person (2 × 193 g = 853 kcal) + 2 tbsp oil. The thigh weight is right (AUSNUT 195 g); references serve 1–1.5 thighs.

saltimbocca_.note: Ours per cutlet plate (4 oz veal + prosciutto + butter/oil); reference per 100 g.

margherita_pizza.note: Slice size: ours is 1 of 8 slices from 2 pizzas' worth of dough; Savvy Bites' pizza ÷ 4. Matches right.

calzone_.note: 6 oz dough per calzone (418). Recipe amount.

frittata_.basis: mean of Hilltop 368 and Recipes from Italy 271 (4 each)
frittata_.note: Recipe: 6 eggs for 4 with no potato; both references add potato or ricotta. Matches right.

arancini_.basis: 525 per serving of 2 (16 a batch) → 263 each
arancini_.note: Ours 409 per ball. Absorbed oil + 16 a batch; check yield.

garlic_bread.note: Slice size: 16 Italian bread slices (29 g, USDA) for 10 servings; Simply Scratch's slices are bigger with more butter.

panzanella_.note: Olive oil: ¼ cup+ for 6 (168 kcal a serving) and 56 g bread each. Recipe amounts.

caponata_.basis: mean of Tastefully Grace 232 and Recipes from Italy 273

spaghetti_and_meatballs.basis: mean of Robin Miller 917 (4) and Once Upon a Chef 731 (6), 1 lb pasta
spaghetti_and_meatballs.note: Recipe amounts: 2 cups cooked spaghetti + 5.6 oz meat in meatballs a plate.

spaghetti_carbonara.basis: 5 servings, 1 lb pasta (Culinary Ginger 480 uses ½ lb for 4)

cacio_e_pepe.note: Reference too low for its own amounts: 1 lb dry spaghetti alone is ~400 kcal a serving before cheese. Ours (2 cups pasta + 1.4 oz pecorino) is plausible.

fettuccine_alfredo.basis: mean of Melissa's 621 and Eazy Peazy 677
fettuccine_alfredo.note: Cream: 1½ cups heavy cream for 4 (309) + butter + parmesan; 2.5 oz dry fettuccine. Recipe amounts.

penne_alla_vodka.basis: 6 servings from 1 lb pasta (about 1.3 cups cooked each; ours 1.25 cups)

shrimp_scampi.basis: 2 servings with ½ lb linguine (4 oz dry each)
shrimp_scampi.note: Pasta: ours is 3 oz dry linguine a plate, Chef Dennis 4 oz; plus less butter. Recipe amounts.

linguine_alle_vongole.basis: mean of Olive 936 and Petite Cook 470

spaghetti_alla_puttanesca.basis: mean of Culinary Ginger 364 and RecipeTin 596

gnocchi_alla_sorrentina.basis: 893 per 2 with 500 g gnocchi, rescaled to our 113 g gnocchi a plate
